Ducks: TV channel and streaming options for November 15
 By Data Skrive Nov. 15, 2026 1:47 pm EST Updated Share article 
 Sunday’s NHL slate will see the Anaheim Ducks (10-9-1) take the ice against the Calgary Flames (9-10-1), starting at 8 p.m. ET at Honda Center and broadcast on ESPN+. The Ducks are ninth (with 21 points) and the Flames 13th (19 points) in the Western Conference.
 How to watch Calgary Flames vs. Anaheim Ducks
 Venue: Honda Center
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 Streaming: ESPN+ (Sign in on ESPN+ with your Fubo account) 
 TV: ESPN+
 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. 
 Calgary vs. Anaheim odds
 Puck Line: Anaheim -1.5 (+153), Calgary +1.5 (-191)
 Favorite Moneyline: Anaheim -154
 Underdog Moneyline: Calgary +126
 Total: 6.5
 Total Over Odds: -129
 Total Under Odds: +104
 Injury reports
 Ducks
 A.J. Greer: Out (Upper Body), 
 Ian Moore: Out (Lower Body), 
 Ryan Poehling: Out (Lower Body)
 Flames
 Jonathan Huberdeau: Out (Hip), 
 Kevin Bahl: Out For Season (Lower Body)
 Advertisement
 Stats to know
 Over 20 games played, Leo Carlsson has put up 27 points (six goals and 21 assists).
 Lukas Dostal has a 4.0 goals-against average, and 238 saves. His .856 save percentage ranks 59th in the league.
 Joel Farabee has 17 points this season (0.9 per game), with seven goals and 10 assists in 20 games (playing 19:10 per game).
 Dustin Wolf has played 11 games this season, conceding 38 goals (3.6 goals-against average) with 267 saves and an .875 save percentage (44th in the league).
